item.title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.

item.tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

answer_sheet.Face and retouching: Keep my facial proportions, expression, apparent age and natural skin texture. No face reshaping or beauty filter.

must_haves: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit this portrait into a professional headshot, changing only the lighting, clothing and background. Preserve the woman's identity and exact facial proportions, face shape, eyes, nose, lips, expression, apparent age, skin tone, natural skin texture and any visible lines or marks. Do not beautify, de-age, reshape facial features, airbrush, blur or smooth the skin. Preserve her dark curly hairstyle, hairline, pose and square chest-up composition. Refine lighting into soft, flattering but realistic studio illumination with natural shadows. Replace the grey knit sweater with a neat tailored dark navy blazer over a simple understated blouse. Replace the park background with a clean neutral light grey studio backdrop. Authentic photographic result, recognisably the same woman, no glamour retouching.
